selected_script.angle: Showcasing the frustrating battle of dealing with greasy countertop spills using lightweight holders, solved by a heavy-duty non-slip matte black stand with an invisible built-in spray bottle.
selected_script.hook: Why does cleaning a simple kitchen spill always turn into a two-handed chaotic mess?

video_001_part_01.description: 0-3s: Hand struggles to tear paper towel from a cheap, tipping holder, causing a roll to unravel into a sticky spill on the kitchen counter. 3-6s: Assembled matte black Ultrean stand is placed on the counter; a single hand tears a sheet cleanly as the heavy base remains rock steady. 6-10s: User presses the top lock button and pulls out the hidden spray bottle to spray cleaner onto the spill.

video_001_part_02.description: 0-4s: Hand wipes the counter clean using the torn paper towel. 4-8s: Hand slides the spray bottle back into the matte black sleeve, clicks it lock, and tears another fresh sheet. 8-10s: Modern kitchen countertop with the sleek matte black stand standing next to fresh fruit. CTA text: 'Upgrade your kitchen setup today.'

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video, realistic 9:16 handheld phone-shot style. Use the provided reference images to keep the product identity: a matte black stainless steel paper towel stand with a heavy circular base, vertical main rod, and angled side tension arm. Keep the outer sleeve solid black, showing no transparent parts when assembled. Timeline: 0-3s: Pain conflict. Close-up of a hand trying to tear paper towel off a flimsy plastic holder which tips over, creating a mess. 3-6s: Product solution. Show the matte black Ultrean stand. A single hand smoothly tears one sheet using the tension arm; the heavy 2.65lb base stays perfectly stable. 6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1. User presses the top lock button, removes the hidden spray bottle (revealing the transparent reservoir only when pulled out), and sprays mist on the spill. No CTA in this segment.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video, 9:16 realistic handheld phone-shot style. This is a continuation of the previous segment, preserving identical matte black product appearance, material, and clean kitchen setting. Timeline: 0-4s: Fast-cut scene 2. Hand uses the torn paper towel to wipe the countertop completely clean. 4-8s: Fast-cut scene 3. Hand inserts the transparent spray bottle back into the solid black vertical rod, clicks it locked, and tears off a fresh sheet with one hand. 8-10s: Light CTA. The fully assembled matte black stand sits elegantly on a modern kitchen counter. Clean text overlay: 'Upgrade your kitchen setup today.'
